speckit.name: Full SDD Cycle
speckit.description: Runs specify → plan → tasks → implement with review gates

bugfix.name: Guided Bug Fix
bugfix.description: Runs bug assess → human review gate → bug fix → bug test on a bug report

assess.name: Idea Assessment Pipeline
assess.description: Runs intake → research → define → shape → decide with a verdict review gate before a manual /speckit.specify handoff

nkda-refine.name: Refine an item
nkda-refine.description: Refining: reads the source of truth, sets scope, reproduces a bug, then moves the item to Refined through its policy

nkda-adopt.name: Adopt a repo
nkda-adopt.description: Moves a repo onto the workflow: board set-up, docs conversion, reconcile of work in flight, carry-over and a final check. Stops for Martin's approval of the docs plan and of the reconcile.
